summary: Kerb with parked cars, flats 17 m away at the top, steep.
reasons: Flats and houses 9-17 m on this side

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 17 m (flats, semi-detached); Elysium 9 m from 24 m onward.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line the kerb, so a van has room beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy road with cycle lanes; constant passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Other cars park along this kerb all day, so a van blends in.

sun_shade: Mostly open; some street-tree shade from the west side.

best_section.where: Indooroopilly Road west kerb at the top of the hill, beside the parked cars
